implementation_notes.N1: '2-layer MLP' (§9) and '2 layers, 256 hidden units' (§5.3) are implemented as two linear layers with one ReLU hidden layer (128 resp. 256 units).
implementation_notes.N10: E1 lower bound = 2.5th percentile of the stratified case bootstrap (two-sided 95 %); E3-site upper bound = 95th percentile (one-sided 95 %, as stated); E2 CI = 2.5th / 97.5th percentiles.
implementation_notes.N11: Secondary-model representation (not fixed in §4.2): KL-VAEs (WF-VAE-L, LeanVAE): the encoder posterior mean; VQ tokenizers (OmniTokenizer, LARP): the codebook-lookup input (after the authors' pre-quantiser projection and L2 normalisation; nothing quantised); averaged over latent time (LARP has none: holistic query tokens) and flattened, as for the Cosmos reference arm; VideoMAE: mean of the last hidden states.
implementation_notes.N12: Compute-budget reduction (b) 'ridge only' is applied as linear learners only (ridge outcome regressions and L2-logistic density ratios).
implementation_notes.N2: MLP mini-batch size: min(200, n_fit) (the scikit-learn 'auto' convention); weight decay as an L2 term added to the gradient of every parameter (torch.optim.Adam semantics); PyTorch nn.Linear default initialisation; early stopping on the inner-validation loss (MSE, binary or multinomial log-loss), patience counted in epochs without a strict improvement, best-epoch parameters restored.
implementation_notes.N3: L2 logistic density-ratio classifier: penalty by inner 5-fold CV (log-loss) over the §9 ridge grid {1e-3..1e3} ('the same two learner families').
implementation_notes.N4: Learner choice (§9): each learner is a procedure (ridge incl. its inner penalty CV; MLP incl. its early stopping); its loss is estimated by 5-fold CV within the outer training fold (case-level), the lower loss wins (ties: the linear learner), and the winner is refitted on the whole outer training fold.
implementation_notes.N5: Ridge / L2-logistic penalty parameterisation: sum of squared errors + λ||b||² resp. sum of log-losses + (λ/2)||b||² (scikit-learn alpha / C = 1/λ conventions), on z-scored features, intercept unpenalised.
implementation_notes.N6: SDR: Díaz et al. (2021) sequential regression V_t = m_t(δA_t, H_t) + r_t (V_{t+1} − m_t(A_t, H_t)), V_K = Y; density ratios r_t = exp(classifier logit) from the stacked (A_t, Λ=0) / (δA_t, Λ=1) classification; no trimming; contrast IF = V_0 − Y; SE = sd(IF, ddof=1)/sqrt(n); 95 % Wald interval.
implementation_notes.N7: Cross-fitting uses the fixed §2 fold labels of the analysis set; training-fold pseudo-outcomes are computed in-sample from the training-fold fits (as in lmtp).
implementation_notes.N8: Seeds: replicate SeedSequence(root, spawn_key=(cell, rep)); named streams are children with an extra spawn key int.from_bytes(name.encode('ascii'), 'big'), e.g. 'c-permutation'.
implementation_notes.N9: Linear site probe (E1, E3-site): multinomial L2 logistic regression with the E2 learner settings (penalty by inner 5-fold CV over {1e-4..1e2}, log-loss).
